name: Interview evaluation
Fresh graduate interview questions
Experienced candidate interview questions
body:
Company: {{company_name}}
{{company_address}}
{{company_email}} | {{company_phone}}
Registration: {{registration_number}}

Candidate: {{candidate_name}}
Role: {{job_title}} | Date: {{interview_date}}
Interviewer: {{interviewer}}

1. Describe the responsibilities most relevant to this role.
2. Which achievement best demonstrates your contribution?
3. What was your personal role in that outcome?
4. How did you measure success?
5. Describe a difficult work problem and your approach.
6. How did you prioritise when resources were limited?
7. Give an example of improving a process.
8. How do you check the quality of your work?
9. Describe a disagreement you helped resolve.
10. How do you communicate risks to others?
11. Tell us about feedback that changed your approach.
12. What did you learn from an unsuccessful project?
13. How do you develop new skills?
14. How do you support colleagues?
15. How do you handle confidential information?
16. What would your first month in this role involve?
17. What support would you need to succeed?
18. What interests you about our work?
19. Which role requirements would you like clarified?
20. What questions would you like to ask us?

Evidence and follow up notes: _____________________________________
